summary.text: ROGALAND RESSURSSENTER AS is a private limited company registered in Avaldsnes, founded 1989-12-18. ROGALAND RESSURSSENTER AS driver rådgivende og tjenesteytende virksomhet rettet mot privat og offentlig næringsliv, og har som formål å øke den samlede kompetansen i næringslivet i regionen gjennom samarbeidsprosjekter. Its main industry code is 70.200: business and other management consultancy activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 10 286 725 NOK and the annual result was 445 508 NOK; operating income was up from 8 306 342 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 48 164 NOK in 2024 to 445 508 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 3 371 224 NOK in 2024 to 3 816 732 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is rrs.no. The latest news on its own website is "Bedre sammen – Bedriftenes Dag 2026" from 2026-10-29. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-15 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
